content: We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts list. Need number of CH3 groups in the compound. Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic, but also could be 20-30. In data we have peaks at 44.06, 34.54 (two), 26.90 (two), 26.18. The aromatic carbons are 147,133.9,128.91 (two),127.68 (two). So aliphatic region: 44.06 likely a carbon attached to heteroatom or quaternary? 34.54 maybe CH2 or CH3. 26.9, 26.18 typical methyl. Need to determine number of CH3 groups. Could use HSQC to see which carbons have attached protons. Let's get HSQC.
